 Arab Weather - The Kingdom has recently witnessed a lack of weather conditions and rain, leading to a weakness in the overall rainfall despite the good start to the autumn season. On a positive note, climate statistics show that the amounts of rain that usually fall during the autumn season do not exceed 11% of the total rainy season in the Kingdom.
 Therefore, the weak rainfall in November is not an accurate indicator of the performance of the entire rainy season, as we expect weather patterns to change later with the arrival of the main winter months.
 Arab Weather experts confirm that the beginning of the season does not necessarily reflect the final performance, making it too early to predict the quality of the rainy season at this stage, especially in light of the continuous changes in global weather systems and their effects on the eastern Mediterranean.
 Despite the rainfall performance to date, the current rainfall situation for the year (2026/2027) is considered relatively better than the situation of the last season (2025/2026). Specialists at the “Arab Weather” Center confirmed that the final total for the rainy season does not depend only on the rainfall during the autumn season, and that there are many rainy seasons that had periods of interruption of rainfall and absence of weather events during the autumn season, while the winter’s forty days compensated for this drought, and the final rainfall totals for the season ended with amounts of rainfall around or even higher than the seasonal averages, as the forty days constitute 30% of the total general rainy season at the level of the Kingdom.
 The main reason for the weak rainfall performance in Jordan during this period is the absence of weather conditions in both its aspects (low-pressure systems or unstable weather conditions), due to the flow of very cold polar air towards different regions of the European continent during the past days, especially the western parts of it, where temperatures dropped below zero degrees Celsius (negative) in many European capitals and snow fell in many parts of them. In contrast, in such weather patterns, the eastern regions of the European continent and the western regions of the Asian continent are affected by high-pressure systems, and this has led to the cold air masses that cause low-pressure systems and unstable weather conditions not reaching the Levant region and the rise in temperatures to much more than their usual averages.
 God’s mercy remains above all things, and we ask the Almighty to bless us with rain.
 And God knows best.
